subs.title: Brand strategy
subs.body: The goal here is to craft a unique brand narrative and thesis. This phase often involves a lot of open conversation and aggregated insights. We avoid a purely statistical approach to brand strategy and like to get in the weeds through thoughtful communication, so we can put our finger on what makes you authentically you.
subs.label: Deliverables

subs.title: Moodboards
subs.body: Before we launch full steam into creative work, we develop moodboards that visually showcase the findings from brand research. They pull references from a wide range of sources that come together to form cohesive visual systems.
subs.label: Deliverables

phases.title: Brand explorations
body: We treat each brand concept as its own separate identity and prepare a presentation that begins with a core brand idea, messaging and tone of voice. Each concept includes its own art direction, typography, visual system and design language. We typically pitch 3 core brand directions to start.
In these explorations we try a wide range of visual techniques to conceptualize each direction.
phases.label: Deliverables

phases.title: Brand iteration and revision
body: This is where we really nail down the brand. We trim the waste, extend the brand and bring in creatives to take it to the next level. These changes are usually holistic iterations, not “make the colour more sharp”.
By the end of this stage, the brand is developed to its final form.
phases.label: Services

phases.title: Logomarks
body: We spend one full week iterating on logomark options and trying out a cohort of ideas. This stage is much more iterative, with a tighter feedback loop, since in our experience a logomark needs a lot of back and forth.
If we move faster here, we spend the extra time building out the brand kit.

phases.title: Brand development
body: This is the core brand execution that typically involves building out the brand further into specific deliverables that will enable you to use this brand at scale. This process involves both producing net new creative assets and documenting + defining existing brand assets.
list: Defining a collection of social media assets (posts, banners, logos, etc)
Documenting a collection of brand artefacts
Defining and documenting a visual language
Extending usage across different branding touchpoints
Exploring opportunities to express the brand through UI and product screens
Building custom tools for scaling brand artefacts
Extending the system into sub-brands for products, events and initiatives

phases.title: Website design
body: Design and iteration of a marketing website of up to 5 pages, built on our brand guidelines and design language. We create the layouts, illustrations and diagrams, animations, iconography and any other design language assets required.

phases.title: Development
body: We develop the final designs in Webflow, Framer or Next.js, set up stylesheets, build any CMS collections, add a class-naming system where it applies, and make the site seamless across devices. Up to 5 pages.

phases.title: Deck
body: A custom branded deck in Figma Slides, exportable as PDF, Google Slides or PowerPoint, built on the new visual language. Up to 10 custom layouts.
phases.label: Deliverables

phases.title: Merchandise
body: Ideation and concept exploration for custom branded merchandise.
phases.label: Deliverables

phases.title: Brand video
body: The best brands come to life with something that truly grabs attention. Here we use the brand assets to put together a unique animated launch video announcing the new brand system.
